ears

Through the study of successful figures such as Disney

topics: Significance of Failures Failure is a student’s daily source of fear
negativity, and depression

units.title: My India My Pride-
topics: Glorious Past - Part 1 India’s ancient Rishis
scholars, and intellectuals have made tremendous contributions to the world
they developed an advanced
sophisticated culture and civilization which began thousands of years ago
Students will learn the importance of studying India’s glorious past so that they could develop a strong passion and pride for our nation

topics: Glorious Past - Part 2 Our ancient concepts can be used to seek revolutionary ideas and to generate inspiration
Students will develop a deeper interest in India’s Glorious Past – by appreciating the need to read about it, research it, write about it, and share it
